en: Colorized view of a broad urban square with a grassy foreground, a long neoclassical building with arcades on the left, a plain three‑story building with a red roof on the right, scattered pedestrians and a small tram in the distance. Printed captions read "Nagyszeben" and "Hermann-tér — Hermannsplatz"; a blue handstamp reads "SIBIU." The reverse has bilingual headings "CARTE POSTALA" and "LEVELEZŐ-LAP," a dotted stamp box and a Budapest printing credit dated 1918.
